533:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I understand. Then the $$クォーター$$ and $$デ・ダナン$$ will keep watch over the area.」

533:t_000:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The Imperial forces were wiped out... Is this a coincidence...?)

533:t_000:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(If it isn't, does whoever eliminated the Empire know what I'm after...?)

533:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've confirmed $$新地球皇国$$ forces! It's the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$'s unit!」

533:t_001:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We've taken aboard everyone who went to the ruins!」

533:t_001:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units at once.」

533:t_002:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! We're picking up where that last concert left off!」

533:t_003:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「That guy $$バサラ$$ is really going all out!」

533:t_003:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He must have been dying to sing some more.」

533:t_003:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's unusual. I never thought $$ゼロ$$ would let $$バサラ$$ do that.」

533:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「An explosive surge of life force will break through this deadlock.」

533:t_003:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So it is the power of life, huh...」

533:t_003:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The Captain is on another mission. I will take command today.」

533:t_003:8.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I know. That one is incompatible with us.」

533:t_003:9.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We $$鬼宿$$ must be the ones to destroy him.」

533:t_003:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Please buy me a little time.」

533:t_003:13.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「It seems we stood out a little too much.」

533:t_003:14.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't worry about them, $$バサラ$$! I'll handle them! You sing!」

533:t_003:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You don't have to tell me!」

533:t_003:16.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! Listen to my soooong!!」

533:t_004:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've detected more units! These are $$ＡＴ$$s!」

533:t_005:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$エルドスピーネ$$! So $$マーティアル$$ is here!」

533:t_005:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「I've heard they're fighting the Empire, though...」

533:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And it looks like we're their next target!」

533:t_006:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Those guys still can't take a hint!」

533:t_006:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...Thanks to them, I have bought enough time.」

533:t_006:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Listen to the melody I play.」

533:t_006:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Zetsu... In... A... Gou... Goku... Shuu...」

533:t_007:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「All the strength... is draining from my body...!」

533:t_007:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The mechanism is unknown. However, Ensign $$レド$$'s physiological functions are clearly declining.」

533:t_007:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「His body temperature and pulse are falling. His pupils are dilating... These symptoms closely resemble death.」

533:t_007:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「It is... dangerous to fight her.」

533:t_007:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ is refusing to fight...!」

533:t_007:8.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So if we stay here, we'll only be waiting to die!」

533:t_007:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Her song is the opposite of the power of life! Only your song can break through it!」

533:t_007:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「You! How can you say that at a time like this!?」

533:t_007:14.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Her song is her song! I'm not gonna use a song to cancel another song out!」

533:t_007:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If we're gonna do this, we're having a jam session!」

533:t_007:17.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「So this is how it ends up, after all.」

533:t_007:18.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「All right! Let's sing our hearts out!」

533:t_009:0.en:
$$シビル$$
「Your song erases $$スピリチア$$! But $$バサラ$$'s song keeps making more $$スピリチア$$!」

533:t_009:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The $$エビル$$ came from another realm, outside the natural order... His song awakened even them to the power of life.」

533:t_009:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$尸刻$$ of the $$鬼宿$$. I believe your original role was to guide departing lives in the proper direction.」

533:t_009:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yet now you defy that order and take lives for no reason!」

533:t_009:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then stick around and listen to my song!」

533:t_009:9.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Come on, $$シビル$$! You sing tooooo!!」

533:t_010:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Wooooo!! The dynamite of this dream collaboration across species is now going off in an EXPLOSION!!」

533:t_010:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「You're getting carried away, $$スカル１$$!」

533:t_010:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$尸刻$$! You are living beings too!」

533:t_010:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I won't let you deny that!」

533:t_010:7.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But we have nowhere to return to, so this is all we can do.」

533:t_011:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You have resolved never to return...」

533:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll shatter that resolve and move forward!」

533:t_011:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「S-somehow, $$ゼロ$$ is... really positive today...!」
